description: This file defines a factory pattern for creating and managing different types of Playwright browser contexts, including shared, isolated, remote, CDP, and persistent contexts. It includes classes and functions for browser lifecycle management, context creation, and configuration handling within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: BaseContextFactory
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing common logic for creating and managing Playwright browser contexts, including browser lifecycle handling and context creation.

classes.name: IsolatedContextFactory
classes.description: Creates isolated browser contexts with specific launch options, supporting trace collection and error handling.

classes.name: CdpContextFactory
classes.description: Creates browser contexts connected over CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol).

classes.name: RemoteContextFactory
classes.description: Creates browser contexts connected to remote endpoints.

classes.name: PersistentContextFactory
classes.description: Creates persistent browser contexts with user data directories, supporting retries and cleanup.

classes.name: SharedContextFactory
classes.description: Singleton class managing shared browser contexts across multiple clients.

methods.name: contextFactory
methods.description: Factory function to select and instantiate the appropriate BrowserContextFactory based on configuration.

methods.name: identityBrowserContextFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory that returns a fixed, existing browser context.

methods.name: computeTracesDir
methods.description: Determines the directory for storing trace files based on configuration and client info.

methods.name: browserContextOptionsFromConfig
methods.description: Generates browser context options based on configuration, including video recording settings.
